title: 0% Description Completeness: Chorley's Transparency Code Breach
summary: Chorley publishes zero transaction descriptions — a statutory breach of Transparency Code 2015 Part 2. 1,409 transactions (£19.5M) have vague or empty descriptions. The 'System' department is 100% vague. Only Burnley shares this failure among Lancashire councils.
